entities.name: Jacob / Israel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Son of Isaac and Rebekah, twin brother of Esau. Renamed "Israel" after wrestling with a divine being at Peniel. Father of the twelve sons who become the twelve tribes of Israel — the foundational ethnic and political structure of ancient Israel.
